summary: scoreRisk must always list a schedule factor, and an ongoing trial whose ESTIMATED primary completion period has fully ended scores 5 points; ACTUAL or untyped dates, and terminal, suspended or UNKNOWN trials, score 0 here.
reason: Without it an ongoing trial years past its own estimate read as zero risk. ACTUAL dates are exempt because follow-up legitimately continues after primary completion, and the status factor already scores UNKNOWN, so counting it again would double the same staleness. The points stay below UNKNOWN's 10 because the registry marks UNKNOWN only after two years overdue. The shared field list also asks for PrimaryCompletionDateType, because CT.gov omits the date type otherwise. Guarded by TestScheduleFactorBranches and TestNormalizedFieldsRequestsPrimaryCompletionType.
validated_outcome: Nine mutations pass the existing risk tests and fail the new file: ACTUAL scoring, month end at its first day, UNKNOWN as ongoing, untyped dates scoring, the call site dropped, the type not copied, points raised to 10, no day-of-month borrow, and the type field dropped from the request. Live check on NCT05711940: the request without the type field returns no type, with it returns ACTUAL.
